text:
lisa: Quick sync 1: we need firm rules for inspect-playback (replaying req/res). Is playback treated as an inspect event for budget/PII?

omar: Yes. playback should consume the inspect budget and inherit the same approval metadata. Otherwise oncall can escalate and leak.

kevin: Also: default deny for capturing embeddings or attachments during playback unless route has `capture_playback=true` and explicit approval recorded.

lisa: Console UX: playback events must be clearly labeled, show `approver`, `approval_ttl`, and a link to the audit entry. One-click expire/renew request for owners.

sre-jen: Oncall constraints: rate-limit playback to 5 requests/min per-tenant, bursting allowed up to 10 for 5s. Emergency override allowed but it must: 1) consume same budget, 2) write immutable audit entry, 3) trigger compliance email.

omar: Fingerprints: HMAC with per-tenant salt + version in the envelope. No raw ids. rotation: rotate salts quarterly, re-hash new incoming items only.

kevin: Sketch of the log envelope we'd emit (metadata-only by default):
```json
{
  "env_v":"v3",
  "tenant":"t-abc",
  "event_type":"playback.inspect",
  "sample_reason":"playback:manual-approve",
  "fingerprint":"hmac-v2:4b8f...",
  "sensitivity":"high",
  "summary":"truncated response text or embedding-id"
}
```

lisa: Retention/TTL: default 30d for sampled playback entries; auto-delete after TTL unless a `legal_hold` tag exists. Legal can request exports via SRE-mediated flow only.

omar: We need a route-level `sensitivity_level` map (low|medium|high). Defaults: api/chat->medium, embeddings/create->high, healthcheck->low. Routes declare their preferred capture policy in config.

kevin: Truncation rules proposal: high -> remove >90% of raw text, keep hash; medium -> keep first 200 chars + hash tail; low -> keep full payload. For embeddings: never persist raw text, only store `embedding_id` + fingerprint.

sre-jen: Runbook for exhausted budget: 1) auto-fallback to metadata-only playback (no payload) 2) notify tenant owners and oncall 3) provide link to request temporary bump (logged).

lisa: Team ask: put initial rollout behind `feature.inspect_playback_v1` flag, test with 2 beta tenants. Console wireframe and copy should avoid showing raw content unless approver + legal hold present.

audit-bot: NOTE: rollout window scheduled 2024-09-20 03:00 UTC for beta tenants; watch `inspect_budget_exhausted` alerts.

omar: I'll draft an RFC covering states (normal/canary/playback/emergency), envelope schema, HMAC rules, TTL, route-sensitivity map, and the console UX copy.

kevin: Please include sample alert thresholds (10% remaining, 0% auto-fallback) and the exact rate-limit numbers in the RFC.

lisa: Thanks. cc security & legal. RFC when ready?

omar: RFC posted: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/r/playback-inspect-v1 -- comments welcome.
